procedures.name: Nightly memory evidence hierarchy
procedures.purpose: Keep nightly memory reconciliation conservative by ranking evidence sources before structured-memory or wiki promotion.
preconditions: Recent evidence sources are available for inspection.
steps: Check recent daily memory notes and workspace memory artifacts first.
Treat dream outputs and recall traces as supporting evidence, not standalone canon.
Use structured-memory ingestion for candidate facts, reflections, and procedures with explicit evidence refs.
Update durable wiki-backed operational memory only when corroborated evidence materially changes operational state or resolves a standing question.
expected_outcomes: Risky or weakly grounded claims do not silently become canon.
rollback: Do not promote the candidate to approved procedure status.
Prefer synthesis-only reporting when evidence is stale or contradictory.
safety_notes: Treat automation as suggestion and reconciliation, not silent canonization for risky domains.
